items.anchor: after `## SFT 数据质量比格式整齐更难`, before `### Distillation 不是“Teacher 越强越好”`
items.delta: Offline scalar/categorical feedback can be compiled into explicit goals, expanded into threshold-indexed sample-goal pairs, and used through the same goal-conditioned interface during training and inference; admission is only part of construction, not the primary mechanism or an online reward model.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Threshold, feedback quantization, repeated pairing, or train-inference goal mismatch can encode bias or discard diversity; retain ordinary SFT and human data curation when the goal state is unstable.

items.anchor: after `## 为什么 Autoregressive 是合理起点`, before `## Diffusion：用迭代修正换并行状态更新`
items.delta: Autoregressive video can keep exact local softmax within a frame while carrying recurrent linear cross-frame memory; all tokens of one frame consume the same pre-update state and the clean pass owns the commit boundary.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Linear memory reduces cross-frame cost but can drift or lose detail; retain full attention or shorter-window recomputation when state quality is uncertain.

items.anchor: after `### Distillation 不是“Teacher 越强越好”`, before `### 多 Teacher Debate 把 Supervision 变成版本化的集体状态`
items.delta: Hybrid vision-language distillation can weight residual alignment by local representation density across a staged teacher-student path; density is an estimator-controlled training state, not semantic truth.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Density estimation can amplify crowded/noisy regions or drift across domains; fall back to uniform residual alignment or the original distillation loss.

items.anchor: after `## QLoRA 进一步减少冻结权重存储`, before `### Bit Width 与 Adapter Rank 共享同一个容量预算`
items.delta: Private data first produces a DP synthetic artifact at cost (epsilon_syn, delta_syn); a selector that only reads that artifact can be frozen before final private LoRA/PEFT as post-processing, while the end-to-end accountant composes synthetic generation with final fine-tuning cost (epsilon_ft, delta_ft).
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: The branch depends on synthetic-to-private transfer, selector stability, noise-matched robustness, and correct two-stage accounting; use random/public selection or more conservative DP-SGD when those assumptions fail.

items.anchor: after `### Query-space Steering 改变的是 QK 路由`, before `## 数值与实现边界`
items.delta: Document parsing can warm up with full visual attention at a focal layer, select query-relevant visual tokens across later layers, and reuse the choice across decode steps while retaining full KV for recovery.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Peak KV memory remains and prefill may not improve; selection errors require fallback to full visual attention.

items.anchor: after `## 它付出了什么`, before `## FlashAttention 优化的是执行，不是模型语义`
items.delta: Attention sinks and residual outliers should be diagnosed as coupled token-axis normalization and depth-axis residual accumulation; a salient token is not a single-cause explanation.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: The decomposition is model- and setup-bound; retain layerwise raw attention/residual measurement when assumptions fail.

items.anchor: after `## Catastrophic forgetting 与能力回退`, before `### Fine-tuning 稳定性还要观察输出空间`
items.delta: Alignment after fine-tuning is a staged training state: Stage 2 reverse fine-tuning can suppress behavior and Stage 3 re-exposure/re-alignment training can restore it rapidly; the evidence does not establish time-only spontaneous rebound after training stops.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Evidence is limited to three base LLMs, narrow datasets, and gradient-bearing staged training; retain matched stage receipts, full safety regression, monitoring, and rollback outside the measured setting.

items.anchor: after `### Query-space Steering 改变的是 QK 路由`, before `## 数值与实现边界`; place adjacent to, but semantically distinct from, FastOCR
items.delta: A visual-only pre-softmax bias can be driven by a pre-RoPE query/key pair gate and applied to selected GQA heads, reallocating visual attention without rewriting the text path.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: The gate is validated on two backbones/benchmarks only; unstable gates fall back to original attention logits.

items.anchor: after `## Mask 定义哪些边可以存在`, before `## 三 token 小例子`
items.delta: Differentiable hierarchical sparsity can use alpha-entmax to select variable chunk support, then inject a stage-one prior before sparse softmax; support selection and value normalization remain separate stages.
items.tradeoff_failure_fallback: Dynamic support adds control and kernel complexity and may become unstable; dense attention remains the fallback.
